This R markdown documents how the GridMET cells used in the Paradise water
balance model (WBM) were chosen. It runs the WBM for all six cells covering the
buffered contributing area, compares them, and records the two cells retained.
The selection rule itself lives in `src/select_climate_cells.R`, which
`MORA_Deep_Dive_workflow.Rmd` uses to filter its climate inputs.

# 1. Setup

```{r setup}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE,
                      message = FALSE,
                      warning = FALSE,
                      eval = TRUE)

# This Rmd lives in Reports/, but all paths (data/, src/, setup.R) are relative
# to the project root. root.dir applies from the next chunk on.
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

# Packages, src/ functions, palette, plot theme, analysis windows, and CRS are
# shared with MORA_Deep_Dive_workflow.Rmd.
source(here::here("Reports/report_setup.R"))

park <- "MORA"

# Hock degree-day melt coefficient used for all WBM runs in this assessment
hock_coef <- 5

```

# 2. Inputs

Contributing area: the current Edith Creek watershed, buffered 2 km, which
defines the six GridMET cells evaluated here.

```{r inputs_area}

system_watershed <- st_read("data/park/MORA/edithcreek_watershed.gpkg", quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_transform(crs_use)

contributing_area <- system_watershed %>%
  st_buffer(2000)

```

GCMs available for the region, with skill ranking (used to download future
climate and to label projections).

```{r inputs_gcms}

all_cfs <-
  read_delim("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rossyndicate/CCRP_automated_climate_futures/master/data/general/GCM_skill_by_region.txt") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Region == "PWR") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(GCM = ifelse(GCM == "HadGEM2-ES.", "HadGEM2-ES365.", GCM),
                GCM = ifelse(GCM == "HadGEM2-CC.", "HadGEM2-CC365.", GCM)) %>%
  tidyr::crossing(data.table(RCP = c("rcp45", "rcp85"))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(GCM = paste0(GCM, RCP)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Skill = ifelse(Rank > 18, "Low Skill", "High Skill"))

```

Historical (GridMET) and future (MACA) climate for every cell. Downloads are
slow, so they are cached; uncomment to rebuild.

```{r inputs_climate}

# clim_hist <- get_climate_historic(sf = contributing_area %>%
#                                     dplyr::mutate(name = "contributing_area"),
#                                   col_name = "name",
#                                   start = "1979-01-01",

#   dplyr::mutate(CF = "Historical",

# saveRDS(clim_hist, "data/park/MORA/clim_hist_extra.rds")
# saveRDS(aoi_gridmet_grid, "data/park/MORA/aoi_gridmet_grid_extra.rds")

clim_hist <- readRDS("data/park/MORA/clim_hist_extra.rds") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(x = round(x, 6),
                y = round(y, 6))

aoi_gridmet_grid <- readRDS("data/park/MORA/aoi_gridmet_grid_extra.rds")

# One point per cell center
clim_pts <- clim_hist %>%
  dplyr::group_by(x, y, area_weight) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(.groups = "drop") %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

# Takes > 1 hr
# clim_fut <- get_climate_future(sf = contributing_area %>%
#                                  dplyr::mutate(name = "contributing_area"),
#                                col_name = "name",
#                                start = "2026-01-01",
#                                end = "2100-12-31",
#                                GCM = all_cfs$GCM,
#                                exact = TRUE,
#                                gridmet_points = clim_pts) %>%
#   dplyr::mutate(GCM = paste0(GCM, ".", RCP)) %>%
#   dplyr::left_join(all_cfs %>% dplyr::select(-"RCP"), by = "GCM") %>%
#   dplyr::select(-c("Ensemble", "RCP"))
# saveRDS(clim_fut, "data/park/MORA/clim_fut_extra.rds")

clim_fut <- readRDS("data/park/MORA/clim_fut_extra.rds") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(x = round(x, 6),
                y = round(y, 6))

# MACA cell centers differ from GridMET's in the last decimals; snap each
# future coordinate to the nearest historical one so cells line up.
get_nearest <- function(fut_vec, hist_vec) {
  u_fut  <- unique(fut_vec)
  u_hist <- unique(hist_vec)
  matched_hist <- u_hist[sapply(u_fut, function(v) which.min(abs(u_hist - v)))]
  matched_hist[match(fut_vec, u_fut)]
}

clim_fut <- clim_fut %>%
  dplyr::mutate(x = get_nearest(x, clim_hist$x),
                y = get_nearest(y, clim_hist$y))

mapview(aoi_gridmet_grid,
        layer.name = "Gridmet Grid",
        color = "red",
        alpha.regions = 0,
        lwd = 3) +
  mapview(clim_pts,
          layer.name = "Grid Points",
          col.regions = "red") +
  mapview(system_watershed,
          col.regions = "dodgerblue",
          layer.name = "Edith Watershed")

```

Paradise SNOTEL (#679) snow water equivalent and water-year cumulative
precipitation, the observed record each cell is compared against.

```{r inputs_snotel}

snotel_daily <- readRDS("data/park/MORA/snotel_daily.rds")

snotel_sites <- snotel_daily %>%
  dplyr::distinct(site, name, latitude, longitude) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs_use)

snotel_paradise <- snotel_daily %>%
  dplyr::filter(name == "Paradise",
                sensor_id %in% c("WTEQ.I", "PREC.I")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(date = as_date(date),
                value = as.numeric(value)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(date, sensor_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(date, water_year, sensor_id, value) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = sensor_id, values_from = value) %>%
  dplyr::rename(swe_in = WTEQ.I,
                precip_in = PREC.I) %>%   # PREC.I is already water-year cumulative
  dplyr::mutate(water_year = as.numeric(water_year))

rm(snotel_daily)

```

# 3. Run the WBM for every cell

The WBM is run for each cell separately (`aggregate = FALSE`), using the same
settings as the report run in `MORA_Deep_Dive_workflow.Rmd`. Future runs start
from the final conditions of the historical run. Runs are cached; uncomment to
rebuild.

```{r wbm_run_all_grids}
hist_wbm <- readRDS("data/park/MORA/hist_wbm_extra.rds")
fut_wbm <- readRDS("data/park/MORA/fut_wbm_extra.rds")

# Cell attributes from the historical run (elevation, slope, aspect, soil
# water capacity, area weight), used to explain differences between cells
cell_attributes <- hist_wbm[[2]] %>%
  dplyr::as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::select(x, y, area_weight, Elev, Slope, Aspect, SWC.Max)

wbm_all <- hist_wbm[[1]] %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(fut_wbm) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(all_cfs %>% dplyr::select(GCM, Skill), by = "GCM")

rm(hist_wbm, fut_wbm)
gc()

cell_attributes

```

# 4. Compare cells

Projected change (2035-2064 relative to 1980-2012) in runoff, temperature, and
precipitation for each cell and GCM.

```{r cell_differentials, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}

wbm_xy_stats <- wbm_all %>%
  dplyr::mutate(year = year(date),
                stat_period = dplyr::case_when(
                  year >= hist_yrs[1] & year <= hist_yrs[2] ~ "Baseline",
                  year >= fut_yrs[1] & year <= fut_yrs[2] ~ "Future",
                  TRUE ~ "Other")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(stat_period != "Other") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(GCM, stat_period, Skill, x, y) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean_precip_in = mean(precip_in_wbm),
                   mean_tmean_C = mean(tmean_C),
                   mean_runoff_in = mean(runoff_in_wbm),
                   .groups = "drop")

baseline_xy <- wbm_xy_stats %>%
  dplyr::filter(stat_period == "Baseline") %>%
  dplyr::select(x, y,
                mean_precip_in_baseline = mean_precip_in,
                mean_tmean_C_baseline = mean_tmean_C,
                mean_runoff_in_baseline = mean_runoff_in)

future_differentials_xy <- wbm_xy_stats %>%
  dplyr::filter(stat_period == "Future") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(baseline_xy, by = c("x", "y")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(delta_precip_in = mean_precip_in - mean_precip_in_baseline,
                delta_tmean_C = mean_tmean_C - mean_tmean_C_baseline,
                delta_runoff_in = 365.25 * (mean_runoff_in - mean_runoff_in_baseline))

# Watershed outline in lon/lat, simplified (the lidar-derived polygon is
# vertex heavy)
watershed <- system_watershed %>%
  st_transform(4326) %>%
  st_simplify(dTolerance = 10)

plot_delta_grid <- function(var, fill_name, palette, title, file) {
  delta_raster <- future_differentials_xy %>%
    dplyr::mutate(x = round(x, 4), y = round(y, 4)) %>%
    dplyr::select(x, y, GCM, dplyr::all_of(var)) %>%
    st_as_stars(dims = c("x", "y", "GCM"), dx = 4000, dy = 4000)

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_stars(data = delta_raster) +
    geom_sf(data = watershed, fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~GCM, ncol = 8) +
    scale_fill_distiller(palette = palette, name = fill_name,
                         direction = 1, na.value = "transparent") +
    theme_wsva() +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())

  ggsave(file, p, dpi = 600)
  p
}

plot_delta_grid("delta_runoff_in", "Delta Runoff (in)", "RdBu",
                "30-Year Runoff Delta by GCM", "data/park/MORA/Figs/delta_runoff_grid.jpg")
plot_delta_grid("delta_tmean_C", "Delta Temp (°C)", "OrRd",
                "30-Year Temp Delta by GCM", "data/park/MORA/Figs/delta_tmean_grid.jpg")
plot_delta_grid("delta_precip_in", "Delta Precip (in)", "BrBG",
                "30-Year Precip Delta by GCM", "data/park/MORA/Figs/delta_precip_grid.jpg")

```

Each cell's historical snowpack and water-year cumulative precipitation for one
water year, against Paradise SNOTEL. Cells kept by `select_climate_cells()` are
drawn in blue; the others in gray.

```{r cell_snow_precip_check}

calibration_water_year <- 2020

selected_cells <- clim_pts %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select_climate_cells() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(selected = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(x, y, selected)

cell_wy <- wbm_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(GCM == "GridMET") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(water_year = calc_water_year(date)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(water_year == calibration_water_year) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(x, y, date) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(x, y) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cum_precip_in_wbm = cumsum(precip_in_wbm)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::left_join(selected_cells, by = c("x", "y")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cell = ifelse(is.na(selected), "Other cell", "Selected cell"),
                coord = paste0(round(x, 3), ", ", round(y, 3)))

snotel_wy <- snotel_paradise %>%
  dplyr::filter(water_year == calibration_water_year)

cell_colors <- c("Selected cell" = "#1b6ca8", "Other cell" = "gray60", "SNOTEL" = "#b02a24")

swe_fig <- ggplot(cell_wy, aes(x = date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = snowpack_in_wbm, group = coord, color = cell), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_line(data = snotel_wy, aes(y = swe_in, color = "SNOTEL"), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual("", values = cell_colors) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Snowpack (in)",
       title = paste0("Water Year ", calibration_water_year, " | Hock Coef: ", hock_coef)) +
  theme_wsva()

precip_fig <- ggplot(cell_wy, aes(x = date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = cum_precip_in_wbm, group = coord, color = cell), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_line(data = snotel_wy, aes(y = precip_in, color = "SNOTEL"), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual("", values = cell_colors) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Cumulative Precip (in)",
       title = paste0("Water Year ", calibration_water_year, " - Cumulative Precip")) +
  theme_wsva()

ggarrange(swe_fig, precip_fig, ncol = 2, common.legend = TRUE, legend = "bottom")

ggsave(paste0("data/park/MORA/Figs/CellCheck_Hock_", hock_coef, "_WY", calibration_water_year, ".jpg"),
       width = 10, height = 4, dpi = 600)

# Snow fit for each cell over the full SNOTEL overlap
cell_snow_fit <- wbm_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(GCM == "GridMET") %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(snotel_paradise, by = "date") %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(swe_in, snowpack_in_wbm) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(x, y) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(rmse_in = Metrics::rmse(swe_in, snowpack_in_wbm),
                   nse = 1 - sum((swe_in - snowpack_in_wbm)^2) / sum((swe_in - mean(swe_in))^2),
                   .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(cell_attributes, by = c("x", "y")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(selected_cells, by = c("x", "y"))

cell_snow_fit

```

# 5. Selected cells

I evaluated the climate grid cells to the west, east, and south of the watershed
(6 total). The 3 southern grids were removed immediately after evaluating
elevation and land cover, leaving the grid the watershed is within and one to
the west and east. Further evaluation showed that the eastern cell, while
tracking cumulative precipitation similarly to the other two cells and the
Paradise SNOTEL station, consistently produced much lower cumulative SWE. This
cell sits at a lower elevation than the other two, so despite comparable
precipitation totals, a greater amount of precipitation falls as rain rather
than snow, driving the divergence in cumulative SWE. Based on this, I retained
only two grid cells for the analysis: the cell containing the watershed and the
cell to the west.

```{r selected_cells}

select_clim_pts <- clim_pts %>%
  select_climate_cells()

select_clim_pts

```

Climate grid figure: all six cells, the two selected, and nearby SNOTEL
stations.

```{r climate_figure}

climate_fig_extent <- aoi_gridmet_grid %>% sf::st_union() %>% sf::st_buffer(6000)
nps_tiles_climate <- get_nps_basemap(aoi = climate_fig_extent, style = "standard", buffer_km = 1, zoom = 13)

climate_fig_bbox <- climate_fig_extent %>%
  sf::st_transform(3857) %>%
  sf::st_bbox()

climate_figure <- ggplot() +
  geom_nps_basemap(nps_tiles_climate) +
  geom_sf(data = sf::st_transform(contributing_area, 3857), aes(fill = "Contributing Area"),
          color = "black", linewidth = 0.25, alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_sf(data = sf::st_transform(aoi_gridmet_grid, 3857), aes(color = "Climate Grid"),
          fill = NA, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_sf(data = sf::st_transform(select_clim_pts, 3857), aes(shape = "Selected Climate Grid"),
          color = "yellow", size = 5, fill = "yellow") +
  geom_sf(data = sf::st_transform(snotel_sites, 3857), aes(shape = "SNOTEL/Weather Station"),
          fill = "royalblue", color = "black", size = 3) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(data = sf::st_transform(snotel_sites, 3857),
                            aes(label = name, geometry = geometry),
                            stat = "sf_coordinates", size = 2.5, label.size = 0,
                            fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.7)) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "", values = c("Contributing Area" = "dodgerblue")) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "", values = c("Climate Grid" = "red")) +
  scale_shape_manual(name = "", values = c("SNOTEL/Weather Station" = 21,
                                           "Selected Climate Grid" = 22)) +
  ggspatial::annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.3) +
  ggspatial::annotation_north_arrow(location = "tr", which_north = "true",
                                    style = ggspatial::north_arrow_fancy_orienteering()) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(climate_fig_bbox["xmin"], climate_fig_bbox["xmax"]),
           ylim = c(climate_fig_bbox["ymin"], climate_fig_bbox["ymax"]),
           crs = 3857, expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

climate_figure

ggsave("data/park/MORA/Figs/climate_grid_fig.jpg", climate_figure, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 600)

```
